description: One market card (country x kind of work), as rebuilt every week: awards and values of the last 24 months, competition (bids, single-bid share), the top winners by awards and by value, SME share, price weight and award vs estimate, main buyers, trend, the open calls closing first and the contracts coming back in the next six months, each with its notice link, plus coverage, the page link and the citation. format=markdown returns the same card as Markdown.

country.description: ISO alpha-3 or alpha-2 code or a country name; ALL for Europe.

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.

name: get_market
title: Get one market card
